title: Teaching a Computer Like Teaching a Puppy

beats.vo: Hey champ, welcome back! I'm so excited about today.
beats.caption: Welcome back, champ!

beats.vo: You finished all of Unit one! You learned what AI is, and you met AI helpers that translate, find the way, and show captions. Give yourself a big pat on the back!
beats.caption: Unit 1 · What Is AI? · done!

beats.vo: Today, we're starting Unit two. It's called, How Machines Learn.
beats.caption: Unit 2 · How Machines Learn

beats.vo: And chapter one has a funny name. Teaching a computer, like teaching a puppy!
beats.caption: Chapter 1 · Teaching a Computer Like a Puppy

beats.vo: A puppy, and a computer? What could they possibly have in common? Let's find out.
beats.caption: A puppy and a computer? Let's find out!

beats.vo: Meet Kabir. And this is his brand new puppy. Her name is Laddoo, because she's round, and golden, and sweet!
beats.caption: Meet Kabir and his puppy, Laddoo!

beats.vo: Kabir wants to teach Laddoo to sit. So he says it once, nice and loud. Sit!
beats.caption: Kabir says it once: "Sit!"

beats.vo: And Laddoo wags her tail, and chases it, round and round and round. Not sitting at all!
beats.caption: Laddoo just chases her tail!

beats.vo: Why didn't Laddoo learn? Kabir did tell her, didn't he? Think about it.
beats.caption: Why didn't Laddoo learn? Think!

beats.vo: Here's the thing. A puppy doesn't learn from just one try. She needs to be shown, again and again.
beats.caption: Puppies need many tries, not just one

beats.vo: So Kabir tries a smarter way. He says sit, and gently helps Laddoo sit down. That shows her what sit means.
beats.caption: 1 · Show: gently help her sit

beats.vo: The moment she sits, Kabir says, good dog! And gives her a treat. Yum! Now Laddoo knows, that was right.
beats.caption: 2 · Praise: "Good dog!" and a treat

beats.vo: Then they practise. Again tomorrow, and the day after that. Many, many tries. And one day, Kabir says sit, and Laddoo sits, every single time!
beats.caption: 3 · Practise: many tries, then she's got it!

beats.vo: Now, here's the cool part. We teach a computer in a very similar way!
beats.caption: We teach a computer in a similar way!

beats.vo: Say we want an AI to know what a cat looks like. We don't just tell it once. We show it lots and lots of cat photos.
beats.caption: Show the AI lots and lots of cat photos

beats.vo: Then it starts guessing. When it's right, we tell it, yes! When it's wrong, we tell it, no. Just like Kabir saying, good dog.
beats.caption: Right? Say yes! Wrong? Say no.

beats.vo: And with more practice, its guesses get better and better. It isn't magic, and it isn't alive. It's finding patterns, in the examples we show it.
beats.caption: More practice → better guesses. Not magic!

beats.vo: Each cat photo has its name stuck on it, like a little sticker that says, cat. That's called a labelled example.
beats.caption: Photo + name sticker = a labelled example

beats.vo: And showing an AI lots and lots of labelled examples has a special name. It's called, training.
beats.caption: Lots of labelled examples = TRAINING

beats.vo: No, not a train ride! Choo choo! Training just means teaching, with lots of examples.
beats.caption: Not a train ride! Teaching with examples.

beats.vo: Let's play. You be the teacher! The AI will guess, and you say yes, or no.
beats.caption: You be the teacher! Say yes or no.

beats.vo: Here's a stripy cat. The AI says, cat. And here's a dog. The AI says, cat. What do you tell it each time? Pause, and think.
beats.caption: The AI says "cat" both times. Yes or no?

beats.vo: Stripy cat? Yes, well done! The dog? No, try again! Your yes and no help the AI learn, just like praise helps Laddoo.
beats.caption: Cat: yes! Dog: no! That helps it learn.

beats.vo: Now, how many photos should we show? Let's try just one. One photo of an orange cat, labelled cat.
beats.caption: Train with just ONE orange cat photo

beats.vo: Then we show it a black cat. And the AI says, not a cat! Oh no. What went wrong? Think.
beats.caption: Black cat? The AI says "not a cat"! Why?

beats.vo: With only one photo, the AI thought orange was part of being a cat! So it thinks all cats are orange. One example is never enough.
beats.caption: It thinks all cats are orange! One isn't enough

beats.vo: But real cats come in so many kinds. Black, white, stripy, big, and tiny!
beats.caption: Black · White · Stripy · Big · Tiny

beats.vo: When the AI sees lots of different cats, it learns what all cats share. Pointy ears, whiskers, and a long tail. Now it can spot a cat it has never seen before!
beats.caption: Many cats → it learns what all cats share

beats.vo: Quick quiz! Which set teaches cat best? One orange cat. Five photos of the same cat. A hundred dog photos. Or a hundred photos of many different cats? Pause, and pick.
beats.caption: Which set teaches "cat" best?

beats.vo: A hundred photos of many different cats! Lots of examples, and lots of kinds. And the dog photos won't teach cat at all!
beats.caption: 100 different cats wins!

beats.vo: So, how do we know if the AI really learned? We do two steps. Step one, train. Show it lots of labelled examples.
beats.caption: Step 1 · TRAIN: lots of labelled examples

beats.vo: Step two, test. Give it a brand new photo, one it has never seen, with no label. And see what it guesses.
beats.caption: Step 2 · TEST: a new photo, see its guess

beats.vo: Wrong guess? No problem. Show it more examples, and test again. First train, then test. Just like Laddoo. If she forgets, Kabir practises with her some more.
beats.caption: Wrong? Train with more, then test again

beats.vo: Okay champ, it's practice check time, just like the quiz.
beats.caption: Your turn: practice check

beats.vo: Kabir wants to teach an AI what a bus is. Should he show one photo, or a hundred? And why? Pause the video, and try it on paper.
beats.caption: Teach "bus": 1 photo or 100? Why?

beats.vo: A hundred photos! Buses come in many colours and sizes. Red city buses, yellow school buses, even double-deckers. With lots of labelled bus photos, the AI learns what all buses share. Not just one bus. Super thinking!
beats.caption: 100! Many kinds → it learns what buses share

beats.vo: Let's remember. Training means showing lots of examples.
beats.caption: Training = showing lots of examples

beats.vo: Labelled examples have their names stuck on them.
beats.caption: Labelled examples have their names on

beats.vo: One example is not enough. Remember the orange cat?
beats.caption: One example is not enough

beats.vo: And first we train, then we test.
beats.caption: First train, then test

beats.vo: Chapter one of Unit two, done! You just learned how computers learn, champ. Laddoo is very proud of you!
beats.caption: Chapter 1 done!

beats.vo: Now let's see what you remember. Tap Finish, and try the quiz. You've got this!
beats.caption: Next: Quiz · Tap Finish
